title: NEXTDAY is the day after the last selected date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = NEXTDAY ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 25 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 2, 28 ) )

source.quote: NEXTDAY returns the day after the last day in the selection

derivation: The last selected date is 2024-02-28; the next day is the leap day 2024-02-29. Sales on that date: 400.
